trap.label: fala com preparo
trap.wrong: I will talk about my city. Firstly, is very big. Second, have many parks.
trap.right: I'd like to talk about my city. First, it is very big. Second, it has many parks.
trap.why: Em português o sujeito é omitido (“é grande”, “tem parques”). Em inglês, o sujeito (it) é obrigatório em cada frase.

fix.wrong: I would like talk about it.
fix.right: I would like to talk about it.

rewrite.prompt: Complete com sujeito: “___ is quiet.” (the town)
Reescreva com abertura: “I talk about my school.” (I’d like...)
rewrite.answer: I'd like to talk about my school.
